product.title: Explore Lima On Bike: Coast Cycling Adventure

description.text: In Lima, this small-group coast ride starts in Miraflores, drops toward Chorrillos, then follows Barranco and Love Park on protected bike paths. Bicycles, helmets, and a cycling guide are included. The published meeting point is Calle Alcanfores 425 in Miraflores, with the end at Church Virgen Milagrosa. Commentary covers coastal neighborhoods and street art rather than a historic-center walking loop. The format suits visitors who want a guided bike outing without renting independently or navigating Lima traffic alone. The published duration is about three hours and fifteen minutes on mixed coastal path and neighborhood streets. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Lima, and the itinerary stays on Chorrillos, Barranco, Love Park, and Miraflores that shape this coastal ride rather than a Huaca Pucllana or downtown plaza add-on.

highlights: Small-group coast bike ride from Miraflores
Guided route through Chorrillos, Barranco, and Love Park
Meeting point on Calle Alcanfores in Miraflores
About 3 hours 15 minutes on coastal paths

end.description: Return to your Lima meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
